title: SCX Universal / Classic / Advance

scope.basis: Modern grey 1:32 Universal track shared by Classic/Original analogue and Advance, plus selected track-mounted devices, borders and elevation hardware from the 2026 catalogue.
scope.availability: Catalogue coverage, including announced products; no claim of current stock or final release appearance.
excluded: Earlier Digital/WOS electronics and electrical compatibility
Complete racing sets, conversion bundles, cars, controllers, transformers and spare car parts
Rally workshop tent and other decorative scenery
Historical 90 mm quarter-straight SKU mapping pending verification

communityMeasurements.note: Diameter reference edge is not specified. Adjacent half-diameter increments are 174.625, 149.225 and 146.05 mm, so these approximations do not establish one consistent nesting width. Reported inside/outside lengths are not labelled radii. Do not derive slot spacing from these values.

sourceIssues.detail: Road width, slot spacing, radii, connector moulds and border footprints remain unresolved. All SVGs are identification illustrations; no snapping or lane-length geometry is enabled.
2026 labels U10323X200 80 mm, while the user-provided 2021 catalogue labels it 90 mm. Community notes identify closing 80 mm and quarter 90 mm as distinct, without resolving this modern SKU.
The user-provided forum excerpt helps establish curve angles and historical references. Approximate diameters are retained with their provenance, not converted into a supposedly exact nesting grid.
2+2, 4+4 and the R1 +4 label do not establish allocation between shoulders, walls or end pieces. Unresolved counts stay null. STD units are carton quantities.
U10474X200 has a coming-soon placeholder in the 2026 catalogue. Its family-based illustration is provisional.
Modern Universal grey track is shared by analogue and Advance. The legacy-black adapter is analogue only. Hornby Scalextric and SCX remain separate systems.
